name: Bulbasaur
flavour_text: For some time after its birth, it uses the nutrients that are packed into the seed on its back in order to grow.

name: Ivysaur
flavour_text: The more sunlight Ivysaur bathes in, the more strength wells up within it, allowing the bud on its back to grow larger.

name: Venusaur
flavour_text: While it basks in the sun, it can convert the light into energy. As a result, it is more powerful in the summertime.

name: Exeggcute
flavour_text: If you touch one of Exeggcute’s heads, mistaking it for an egg, the other heads will quickly gather and attack you in a swarm.

name: Pinsir
flavour_text: These Pokémon judge one another based on pincers. Thicker, more impressive pincers make for more popularity with the opposite gender.

name: Combee
flavour_text: At night, Combee sleep in a group of about a hundred, packed closely together in a lump.

name: Vespiquen
flavour_text: It houses its colony in cells in its body and releases various pheromones to make those grubs do its bidding.

name: Deerling
flavour_text: These Pokémon are not shy—they will behave as they please, even in front of people. If you feed one of them, it will quickly take a liking to you.

name: Sawsbuck
flavour_text: There are many Sawsbuck enthusiasts. The darker the red of the foliage that hangs from its antlers, the more stylish the Sawsbuck is thought to be.

name: Foongus
flavour_text: There is a theory that the developer of the modern-day Poké Ball really liked Foongus, but this has not been confirmed.

name: Amoonguss
flavour_text: Be wary of the poisonous spores it releases. Mushrooms resembling Amoonguss’s caps will grow out of anywhere the spores touch.

name: Genesect
flavour_text: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.

name: Cutiefly
flavour_text: When it senses the auras of people or Pokémon who are having fun, it will draw close and give them a painful poke with its long proboscis.

name: Ribombee
flavour_text: Ribombee can sense when people or Pokémon are feeling down, and it will cheer them up with handmade pollen puffs.

name: Charmander
flavour_text: The flame on its tail shows the strength of its life-force. If Charmander is weak, the flame also burns weakly.

name: Charmeleon
flavour_text: When it swings its burning tail, the temperature around it rises higher and higher, tormenting its opponents.

name: Charizard
flavour_text: If Charizard becomes truly angered, the flame at the tip of its tail burns in a light blue shade.

name: Volcanion
flavour_text: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It’s said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

name: Salandit
flavour_text: It taunts its prey and lures them into narrow, rocky areas where it then sprays them with toxic gas to make them dizzy and take them down.

name: Salazzle
flavour_text: Salazzle makes its opponents light-headed with poisonous gas, then captivates them with alluring movements to turn them into loyal servants.

name: Scorbunny
flavour_text: Once its body has heated up, Scorbunny can use the full extent of its power. That’s why it does warm-up exercises.

name: Raboot
flavour_text: Thanks to its soft and fluffy fur, Raboot can easily heat up its fire energy and produce flames with more power.

name: Cinderace
flavour_text: Although Cinderace loses its cool easily, it will battle flawlessly for a Trainer it trusts.

name: Charcadet
flavour_text: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

name: Armarouge
flavour_text: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

name: Ceruledge
flavour_text: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

name: Squirtle
flavour_text: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. It sprays a potent foam from its mouth.

name: Wartortle
flavour_text: Wartortle’s long, furry tail is a symbol of longevity, so this Pokémon is quite popular among older people.

name: Blastoise
flavour_text: It deliberately increases its body weight so it can withstand the recoil of the water jets it fires.

name: Seel
flavour_text: The protrusion on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.

name: Dewgong
flavour_text: It sleeps under shallow ocean waters during the day, then looks for food at night when it’s colder.

name: Shellder
flavour_text: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.

name: Cloyster
flavour_text: Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.

name: Jynx
flavour_text: In certain parts of Galar, Jynx was once feared and worshiped as the Queen of Ice.

name: Lapras
flavour_text: It ferries people across the sea on its back. It may sing an enchanting cry if it is in a good mood.

name: Palkia
flavour_text: It is said to live in a gap in the spatial dimension parallel to ours. It appears in mythology.

name: Basculin
flavour_text: These Pokémon form schools with others of the same color. The greatest foe of a school of blue Basculin is a school of red Basculin.

name: Froakie
flavour_text: Its happy-go-lucky look is an act intended to fool its enemies. It will suddenly drop the facade and overwhelm its foes with its blinding speed.

name: Frogadier
flavour_text: It excels at devising battle strategies that make use of the terrain, and it never misses its mark when throwing bubble-covered pebbles.

name: Voltorb
flavour_text: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

name: Electrode
flavour_text: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

name: Stunfisk
flavour_text: Thanks to bacteria that lived in the mud flats with it, this Pokémon developed the organs it uses to generate electricity.

name: Zeraora
flavour_text: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they’ll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

name: Pawmi
flavour_text: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.

name: Pawmo
flavour_text: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

name: Pawmot
flavour_text: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

name: Jigglypuff
flavour_text: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

name: Wigglytuff
flavour_text: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.

name: Abra
flavour_text: This Pokémon uses its psychic powers while it sleeps. The contents of Abra’s dreams affect the powers that the Pokémon wields.

name: Kadabra
flavour_text: Using its psychic power, Kadabra levitates as it sleeps. It uses its springy tail as a pillow.

name: Alakazam
flavour_text: It has an incredibly high level of intelligence. Some say that Alakazam remembers everything that ever happens to it, from birth till death.

name: Marill
flavour_text: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry even when it plays in the water.

name: Azumarill
flavour_text: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of things in water and tell what they are.

name: Espeon
flavour_text: The tip of its forked tail quivers when it is predicting its opponent’s next move.

name: Wobbuffet
flavour_text: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to pump up its counterstrike.

name: Deoxys
flavour_text: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

name: Mimikyu
flavour_text: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

name: Cosmog
flavour_text: This Pokémon came from another universe. Its gaseous body is so light that even a gentle breeze can blow it away.

name: Cosmoem
flavour_text: The absorption of starlight fuels this Pokémon’s growth. The shell that encases it is harder than any known material.

name: Lunala
flavour_text: Known as the Beast That Calls the Moon, this Pokémon lives by taking in any and all light and converting it into its own energy.

name: Diglett
flavour_text: It lives about one yard underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.

name: Dugtrio
flavour_text: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.

name: Rhyhorn
flavour_text: Rhyhorn claims an area with over a six mile radius as its territory. It apparently forgets where this territory is when running, however.

name: Rhydon
flavour_text: The horn of a Rhydon is powerful enough to crush raw diamonds. These Pokémon polish their horns by bashing them together.

name: Rhyperior
flavour_text: This Pokémon’s sturdy carapace protects it from volcanic eruptions. It shoots round rocks from the holes in its hands.

name: Sudowoodo
flavour_text: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation.

name: Paldean Wooper
flavour_text: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

name: Paldean Clodsire
flavour_text: When attacked, this Pokémon will retaliate by sticking thick spines out from its body. It’s a risky move that puts everything on the line.

name: Larvitar
flavour_text: Born deep underground, this Pokémon becomes a pupa after eating enough dirt to make a mountain.

name: Pupitar
flavour_text: This pupa flies around wildly by venting with great force the gas pressurized inside its body.

name: Barboach
flavour_text: Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in muddy waters, it can detect its prey’s location.

name: Whiscash
flavour_text: It is extremely protective of its territory. If any foe approaches, it attacks using vicious tremors.

name: Rockruff
flavour_text: This Pokémon is very friendly when it’s young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

name: Gastly
flavour_text: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

name: Haunter
flavour_text: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

name: Gengar
flavour_text: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey’s shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.

name: Umbreon
flavour_text: When exposed to the moon’s aura, the rings on its body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious power.

name: Seviper
flavour_text: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes unwary prey with venomous fangs.

name: Zorua
flavour_text: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

name: Zoroark
flavour_text: Stories say those who tried to catch Zoroark were trapped in an illusion and punished.

name: Nickit
flavour_text: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

name: Thievul
flavour_text: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

name: Dialga
flavour_text: A Pokémon spoken of in legend. It is said that time began moving when Dialga was born.

name: Ferroseed
flavour_text: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn’t very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.

name: Ferrothorn
flavour_text: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

name: Solgaleo
flavour_text: When light radiates from its body, this Pokémon could almost appear to be the sun. It will dispel any darkness and light up the world.

name: Meltan
flavour_text: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.

name: Melmetal
flavour_text: At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and fall apart. The small shards left behind will eventually be reborn as Meltan.

name: Dratini
flavour_text: It sheds many layers of skin as it grows larger. During this process, it is protected by a rapid waterfall.

name: Dragonair
flavour_text: They say that if it emits an aura from its whole body, the weather will begin to change instantly.

name: Pidgey
flavour_text: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

name: Pidgeotto
flavour_text: The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an Exeggcute to its nest over 60 miles away.

name: Pidgeot
flavour_text: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.

name: Spearow
flavour_text: Its reckless nature leads it to stand up to others—even large Pokémon—if it has to protect its territory.

name: Fearow
flavour_text: Carrying food through Fearow’s territory is dangerous. It will snatch the food away from you in a flash!

name: Eevee
flavour_text: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

name: Porygon
flavour_text: It is an artificial Pokémon. Since it doesn’t breathe, people are excited by its potential to be useful in any environment.

name: Porygon2
flavour_text: This artificial Pokémon evolved thanks to cutting- edge science. It sometimes displays behavior that is not in its programming.

name: Porygon-Z
flavour_text: An additional program was installed to create a more advanced Pokémon, but it was apparently flawed. Porygon-Z moves oddly as a result.

name: Snorlax
flavour_text: This gluttonous Pokémon eats constantly, apart from when it’s asleep. It devours nearly 900 pounds of food per day.

name: Zangoose
flavour_text: It’s Seviper’s archrival. To threaten those it encounters, it fans out the claws on its front paws.

name: Bidoof
flavour_text: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

name: Bibarel
flavour_text: It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.

name: Buneary
flavour_text: If both of Buneary’s ears are rolled up, something is wrong with its body or mind. It’s a sure sign the Pokémon is in need of care.

name: Lopunny
flavour_text: Lopunny is constantly monitoring its surroundings. If danger approaches, this Pokémon responds with superdestructive kicks.

name: Stufful
flavour_text: Its fluffy fur is a delight to pet, but carelessly reaching out to touch this Pokémon could result in painful retaliation.

name: Celebi
flavour_text: This Pokémon traveled through time to come from the future. It bolsters grass and trees with its own strength, and it can heal wounds, too.

name: Treecko
flavour_text: Treecko can quickly scale even vertical surfaces. It senses humidity with its tail to predict the next day’s weather.

name: Grovyle
flavour_text: Grovyle leaps from branch to branch in large trees, moving with ease. It propels itself with astounding speed and force.

name: Cyndaquil
flavour_text: The fire that spouts from its back burns hottest when it is angry. The flaring flames intimidate foes.

name: Quilava
flavour_text: The fur covering this Pokémon’s body never burns, no matter what. It can shrug off any kind of fire attack.

name: Pachirisu
flavour_text: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.
